item.excerpt:

The S-swim action creates a lot of flash to mimic a fleeing baitfish.

Excellent for tuna and pelagics!

  • Length 230 mm

  • Gr. 130

A must for EXOTIC FISHING

nextItem.title: Lazarat Griffon Diving 230
nextItem.excerpt:
Floating 230mm 145g 

Rigging option:

Hooks: Bkk lone diablo 13/0 or Bkk gt rex 6/0 (weight around 15g)

Split rings: size 10+/11

Action:

When retrieved quickly with a long swipe, it leaves a bubble trail behind, wobbling its body underwater. On shorter swipes and slower retrieves, it offers versatility, allowing you to experiment with various techniques. Fish often strike when it surfaces after a pull, so it’s best to pause for a second and let it float between retrieves. 

The Griffon is a slim-style wooden floating lure series, featuring smallmouth poppers and diving poppers in various sizes. It offers long, stable casting, is easy to use, and highly durable. Built with a 2mm stainless steel through-body construction and coated with six layers of premium-quality epoxy for maximum durability.
